comment: Unguarded sequence: a mutating step after `;` or a newline whose earlier step may have failed (must deny, naming each step) and look-alikes that are guarded or do not mutate (must allow). Replays are verbatim Bash tool commands from the transcripts.

deny.name: 2026-10-27 replay: deploy.sh after a refused tools/lane promote
deny.command: set -o pipefail; P=/private/tmp/claude-501/-home-app/32d15c03-0292-4696-8d98-62c1fd05d847/scratchpad; $P/land.sh 548-touch-surface-per-remote {home}/app/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab517696d28306c91; cd {home}/app/.claude/worktrees/integrate-queue-347 && S=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && echo "promote $S" && APP_LANE_CAP=16 tools/lane promote $S > $P/promote5.log 2>&1 && tail -1 $P/promote5.log && cd ../batch-gate && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$S" && ./install-control-app.sh > $P/install5.log 2>&1 && python3 tools/check-installed.py --expect $S 2>&1 | grep -v '^ok' | head -6; O=$P/link-pkg5; rm -rf $O && tools/app-link/build-package.sh $O linux/amd64 > $O.build.log 2>&1 && APP_LINK_PACKAGE=$O tools/app-link/deploy.sh max@192.0.2.10 2>&1 | tail -2; tail -4 $P/promote5.log
